292a2165ca76645d.job_title: Principal Specialist Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology)
292a2165ca76645d.description: About Maaden Maaden, established in 1997, is recognized as one of the fastest-growing mining companies globally and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is instrumental in developing the mining industry to become a key pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building an integrated mining value chain. Role Overview The Principal Specialist, Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology) will establish the data modeling and architecture foundation for Operational Technology (OT) and industrial data across plants, sites, and operational systems. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, is crucial for enabling trusted OT analytics by standardizing data representation, governance, and alignment with enterprise IT data products for assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, production contexts, historians, SCADA/DCS, and condition monitoring data. Key Responsibilities Define enterprise OT data modeling standards for time-series data, events, alarms, assets, tags, measurements, and production contexts. Establish canonical OT concepts including asset hierarchy, location hierarchy, tag naming, measurement definitions, and work order linkage. Design scalable data schemas for curated OT layers and reusable OT data products with auditability, lineage, and quality attributes. Architect OT-to-IT data alignment patterns that connect operational measurements with enterprise entities for reporting and analytics. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Embed governance-by-design into OT data models, including ownership, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and lifecycle controls. Partner with OT engineering, cybersecurity, data platform, and infrastructure teams to design secure and compliant OT data flows. Review solution designs, data models, vendor deliverables, and integration approaches to ensure architectural consistency. Provide technical leadership on OT semantics, industrial data architecture, data modeling practices, and data product design. Coach engineers, data modelers, platform teams, and solution teams on OT modeling standards and implementation practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in data modeling and architecture, specifically within Operational Technology environments. Demonstrated ability to address high-volume industrial data, latency requirements, site variability, and intermittent connectivity in modeling patterns. Experience in aligning historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production data with enterprise data products. Proficiency in defining quality attributes for historian data, including compression, interpolation, quality flags, sampling frequency, and streaming patterns. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity requirements, segmentation, access control, and operational resilience. Measures of Success Success in this role will be demonstrated by the consistent adoption of standard OT data models across sites, platforms, and industrial systems. This includes the consistent representation of assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, and production contexts for trusted analytics. Effective OT-to-IT integration patterns that enable reliable cross-domain reporting, performance analysis, and data product development are also key indicators. Additionally, the role's success will be measured by curated OT layers that feature clear lineage, quality rules, auditability, and governance controls, alongside accelerated site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse through practical reference patterns.

29b038681b635c87.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems serves as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor for providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia under existing Government-to-Government arrangements. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia supports the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through the growth of Saudi National Partner Companies, reinforcing industrialisation and partnerships. The Role of Asset Planner This full-time role involves performing asset management and planning within the Fleet Management section of the Typhoon Support Centre (TSC) in Taif, KSA. The Asset Planner will report to the Fleet Plans and Statement of Requirement (SoR) Team Leader. The primary objective is to ensure that the RSAF Typhoon fleet’s Line Replaceable Items (LRIs) are effectively managed and maintained in accordance with RSAF fleet plans and mandatory continuing airworthiness requirements. This position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide proactive support and coordinated management of the Typhoon fleet’s LRIs, in coordination with the Integrated Logistics Operations Centre (ILOC). Ensure scheduled maintenance requirements, upgrades, capability insertions, maintenance programme changes, and operational requirements are planned and accomplished effectively. Interface directly with the RSAF at all levels to enhance understanding of Typhoon LRI management requirements and priorities. Assist with the development of Saudi National expertise in Typhoon fleet management. Support the creation of tactical and strategic LRI management plans for endorsement by the TSC Commander (TSC Cdr), considering scheduled maintenance, modifications, and capability upgrades. Monitor lifing metric consumption across the Typhoon fleet LRIs and compile reports/recommendations for RSAF approval to support fleet planning and ensure effective life consumption distribution. Review Technical Instruction (TI) requirements with TSC Business Data personnel, Forward Operations, and Supply to assess impact on fleet LRIs and recommend embodiment strategies for RSAF HQ endorsement. Monitor maintenance scheduling effectiveness and compliance of Typhoon fleet LRIs against approved maintenance programme requirements. Coordinate reviews of reports and recommendations from the TSC In Service Data Analysis (ISDA) team with TSC Technical Specialists and Forward Operations personnel to determine appropriate actions or initiate further investigation. Initiate ad-hoc analysis of Typhoon sub-system data by the TSC ISDA team and relevant Technical Specialists to identify trends and opportunities for development and improvements. Develop and maintain TSC Processes and Procedures related to fleet LRI management and planning. Generate and maintain status reports relevant to fleet LRI management. Undertake additional tasks as requested by TSC and RSAF management. Assist in providing structured On-the-Job training for RSAF and/or Saudi National fleet management staff through training, coaching, work experience, and mentoring. Qualifications and Requirements Essential: Degree-level qualification, or equivalent, in an Aeronautical/Mechanical engineering discipline. Experience in aircraft support/maintenance management. Knowledge of aircraft fleet or LRI management principles and practices, including continuing airworthiness management requirements. Advantageous: Knowledge of the Typhoon fleet and LRI management requirements of the Engineering Support System (ESS). Proficiency in using the Microsoft Office suite of programmes. Experience from within BAE Systems or current service within the RAF/RSAF, demonstrating familiarity with Typhoon fleet management requirements and maintenance management systems.

29c9d4455cd0f65c.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة اول و تالي التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. نظرة عامة على الدور يتولى موظف الصندوق مسؤولية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود، واستلام المدفوعات بمختلف الطرق، وتحديث قوائم الأسعار. كما يشمل الدور تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والتعامل مع طلبات العملاء المتعلقة بقوائم الشراء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني ومرحب، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق شركة اول و تالي التجارية في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والتركيز في التعاملات المالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

29ddbf104c5981cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. الهدف العام للوظيفة يشارك المدير الإداري في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، ويشرف على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. كما يتابع كافة العمليات الإدارية ذات الصلة، ويضمن توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بأقصى كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المختلفة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المتبعة، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف وتنفيذ الخطط. مهارات إشرافية وتنظيمية قوية. بيئة العمل يعمل المدير الإداري بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة في العمليات الإدارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

29915e759cf9cfff.description: Our subsidiary (Adree) is seeking a results-driven Delivery, Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects and digital solutions, ensuring successful execution within agreed timelines, scope, quality, and budget. The role requires strong experience in IT delivery, software development, digital transformation, and managing cross-functional technical teams. The successful candidate will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and senior management to ensure successful project delivery across the Saudi market. Key Responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end delivery of software development, digital transformation, and IT projects from initiation through deployment and handover. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, quality, risks, and dependencies. Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams including software development, QA, DevOps, business analysis, and other technical functions. Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders, managing expectations, requirements, escalations, and delivery updates. Manage Agile/Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery governance. Monitor project progress and delivery performance through KPIs, SLAs, sprint velocity, burndown, defect rates, and milestone completion. Identify and resolve project risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies in a timely manner. Manage relationships with vendors, third-party providers, and technology partners. Ensure solutions meet business requirements, technical standards, quality expectations, and compliance requirements. Manage project resources, team capacity, workload, and delivery priorities. Monitor project financial performance and ensure delivery remains within the approved budget. Coordinate project planning, status reporting, governance meetings, and executive-level updates. Ensure effective testing, quality assurance, deployment, and client handover. Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and post-implementation reviews. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. 6–8+ years of experience in IT delivery, project management, software development management, or digital transformation. Minimum 3 years of experience in a Delivery Manager, Delivery Lead, or similar leadership role . Proven experience delivering large-scale enterprise software, web, mobile, or digital transformation projects. Strong experience in client-facing project delivery and stakeholder management . Experience managing external vendors, third-party providers, and technology partners. Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and/or hybrid delivery methodologies . Good understanding of SDLC, software development, cloud technologies, APIs, microservices, and enterprise applications. Experience working with technologies such as .NET, Azure, OutSystems, Creatio, or similar enterprise technology platforms is preferred. Experience with delivery and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project . Strong understanding of project financial management, resource planning, risk management, and delivery governance. Excellent communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage delivery without direct hierarchical authority. PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar certifications are preferred. Previous experience in a technology consultancy, system integrator, or client-site delivery environment is preferred. Saudi/GCC market experience is preferred. Job Location : HQ

296b0c9eab406515.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إسناد المتجددة للسلامه شخص واحد عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة للمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية، وتشمل: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وشبكات النقل والتوزيع. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع بكفاءة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص المشكلات الفنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للمهندس الكهربائي تطوير مهاراته والمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

29ed062cc6771a68.description: About the Role SAMI Airbus is seeking an MCC Engineer to join their team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring optimal in-service support and maintenance solutions, contributing to excellent fleet availability while upholding the highest quality and safety standards. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to support the Maintenance Control Center (MCC) in achieving operational excellence. The MCC Engineer will play a key role in managing maintenance tasks from initiation through to completion, ensuring efficient aircraft recovery and adherence to maintenance schedules. Key Responsibilities Serve as a cross-functional point for evaluating maintenance tasks received from CAMO and overseeing their execution through the MRO until closure. Arrange necessary tools, materials, hangar space, and manpower for both scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities. Manage Aircraft On Ground (AOG) situations by coordinating with all stakeholders to facilitate aircraft recovery. Review and evaluate Pilot Fault Reports (PFRs) and plan corrective actions as required. Monitor and evaluate Minimum Equipment List (MEL) and Configuration Deviation List (CDL) items, planning maintenance actions for their timely closure. Support long-term planning and create short-term plans for aircraft maintenance. Create and manage work packages in the ERP system and maintain hard copies for Line/Base maintenance. Monitor aircraft logbooks and manage any discrepancies identified. Maintain technical records in the ERP system for the assigned fleet. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering. Formal training on Airbus Fleet. A minimum of four (4) years of experience working in an MCC or a similar environment. Leverage Manufacturing Execution System (MES), Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), and historian analytics to identify and eliminate losses. Enforce High Voltage (HV) Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), HV Interlock (HVIL) continuity, and mandatory HV Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for all work on or near EV Powertrain equipment. Comply with SASO, Saudi MOL, IEC 60204, and functional safety standards (ISO 13849 / IEC 62061). Support Factory Acceptance Test (FAT)/Site Acceptance Test (SAT), commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate, and capacity verification with objective evidence and disciplined punch-list closure. Control production, process, software, and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, revision history, and rollback or containment planning. Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, Process Confirmation, and QRQC/RCCA; close assigned actions with verified effectiveness. Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work, and PPE requirements; never bypass safety devices or product protections. Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control, and audit-ready objective evidence. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in process engineering, preferably within a manufacturing environment. 29333f1490b27ae6.description: . PURPOSE OF THE POSITION The Support Manager consolidates under a single leadership the technical know-how, information systems, supply chain, inventory and investment project functions of Metals, ensuring that the operating divisions receive consistent, timely and fact-based support. The position exists to guarantee that technical knowledge is captured, standardised and transferred across the organisation; that information systems and data integrity underpin management decisions; that materials, supplies and inventories are managed with the accuracy and discipline required by a non-ferrous manufacturing environment; and that investment projects are centrally structured, evaluated and followed through to completion. The role operates primarily on a project basis: each priority initiative is set up as a defined project with objectives, scope, resources, milestones and measurable results, coordinating the contribution of the different areas involved. Beyond the direct management of the functions listed above, the Support Manager acts as an integrating and impartial interface between the departments of Metals and, where relevant, its counterparts within the Electric Group, translating operational issues into structured analysis and actionable recommendations for Executive Management. 2. AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY 2.1 Know-How: Process Engineering, Materials and Continuous Improvement ▪ Own the Company's technical standards for manufacturing processes, including operating parameters, process windows, capability studies and troubleshooting methodologies. ▪ Lead root-cause analysis of recurring process deviations, quality incidents and yield losses, ensuring corrective actions are verified and sustained. ▪ Manage the materials function: raw material and consumable specifications, technical qualification of suppliers, incoming acceptance criteria, alternative material evaluation and failure analysis. ▪ Direct the continuous improvement programme (Lean / Six Sigma / Kaizen), with measurable targets on OEE, scrap and yield, changeover time, energy consumption and cost per tonne. ▪ Build and maintain the Company's technical documentation and know-how repository, ensuring that best practices developed in one division are transferred and standardised across the others. ▪ Provide technical support to capital projects: specification review, technology benchmarking, commissioning support and post-investment performance verification. 2.2 Information Technology ▪ Define and execute the IT roadmap in alignment with the Company's operational and commercial priorities. ▪ Ensure the reliability, availability and security of infrastructure, networks and business applications, including cybersecurity policy and business continuity planning. ▪ Act as the business owner of the ERP. Working hand in hand with the IT Analyst, define and maintain the fundamentals on which the system is built — organisational structure, product and material coding, bills of materials, routings, costing model, stock movements and transaction logic — ensuring at all times that the ERP reflects how the business actually operates rather than the reverse. ▪ Keep the ERP aligned with the evolution of the business: assess the impact of new products, processes, divisions, plants or commercial models on the system's design, and lead the corresponding configuration or development changes in a controlled and documented manner. ▪ Translate business requirements into functional specifications for the IT Analyst and external providers, validate the resulting solutions before deployment, and ensure user training and adoption. ▪ Own master data governance, process mapping, user discipline and the integrity of the data used for management reporting, guaranteeing a single, reliable source of information for decision-making. ▪ Drive digitalisation of shop-floor data capture, production reporting and management dashboards, reducing manual consolidation and reporting lead times. ▪ Manage IT budgets, service providers, licensing and service levels. 2.3 Supply Chain ▪ Ensure continuity of supply of raw materials, consumables, spare parts and services at competitive total cost, in coordination with Procurement and Production Planning. ▪ Establish and monitor supplier performance in delivery, lead time, documentation and technical compliance, escalating deviations with supporting evidence. ▪ Oversee logistics, imports and customs coordination, ensuring compliance with local regulations and correct documentation flow. ▪ Support the sales and operations planning cycle, aligning demand forecasts, production capacity and material availability. 2.4 Inventory Management ▪ Own inventory accuracy across all locations, implementing cycle counting, reconciliation procedures and clear accountability for stock movements. ▪ Define and maintain stock policies: minimum and maximum levels, reorder points, safety stock and coverage targets by material category. ▪ Control slow-moving, obsolete and non-conforming stock, proposing disposal, reprocessing or re-use routes. ▪ Work side by side with the Cost Controlling Department, ensuring full consistency between physical stock records, standard and actual costs, consumption variances and month-end valuation; jointly investigate and explain any deviation. ▪ Ensure rigorous metal balance reconciliation between physical inventory, production records and financial records. ▪ Optimise working capital tied up in inventory without compromising service levels to production and customers. 2.5 Investment Projects ▪ Act as the single point of centralisation for the Company's investment projects, maintaining a consolidated portfolio with scope, status, budget, schedule and expected returns. ▪ Standardise the investment process: preparation of investment requests, technical specification, supplier and technology benchmarking, quotation comparison and risk assessment. ▪ Build the economic evaluation of each project — CAPEX, operating cost impact, payback, IRR and sensitivity analysis — in cooperation with Cost Controlling and Finance, and present it to the Investment Committee in decision-ready format. ▪ Coordinate project execution across engineering, production, maintenance, supply chain, IT and external contractors, ensuring milestones, budget and safety requirements are met. ▪ Manage commissioning, ramp-up and hand-over to operations, followed by post-investment review comparing actual performance against the approved business case. 2.6 Coordination with the Systems Department — Environment, Health & Safety ▪ Coordinate with the Systems Department to ensure that environmental and safety requirements are embedded in process design, materials selection, IT systems and supply chain practices. ▪ Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Company's certified management systems (quality, environment, occupational health and safety, energy) within the scope of the areas under this position. ▪ Ensure that technical and improvement projects incorporate environmental compliance, emissions, waste and safety considerations from the design stage. 3. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL MANDATE ▪ Structure the Company's priority initiatives as defined projects — objectives, scope, resources, milestones, owners and measurable results — and lead them personally, mobilising the different areas involved without duplicating their line responsibilities. ▪ Act as a neutral facilitator between the operational, technical and commercial departments of Metals and its counterparts within the Electric Group, resolving interface issues before they escalate into operational or client-facing problems. ▪ Chair or coordinate cross-departmental review meetings on matters involving more than one division, ensuring that agreed actions have owners, deadlines and verified closure. ▪ Prepare consolidated, fact-based analyses and recommendations for Executive Management, including options, risks, quantified impact and implementation requirement
